items.title: Not moving jobs, states or starting businesses: Data says Australians are stuck
items.description: People are less mobile, less dynamic and more risk-averse than we used to be, a series of economic indicators shows.

items.title: The migration maths behind the housing crisis is not what politicians claim
items.description: Arthur Calwell argued migration was essential to national survival. Today, the Coalition says it should depend on how many homes get built, but the economics are far from straightforward.

items.title: The link between terrorism and DV could be key to preventing homicide
items.description: A world-first research project is aiming to prevent family and intimate partner homicides with similar strategies to those being used to tackle terrorism and lone-actor attacks.

items.title: Pocock open to party of independents as One Nation support climbs
items.description: The independent senator says Australians are frustrated with a political system that "does not work for them".

items.title: Man dies after shark attack in Far North Queensland
items.description: A 39-year-old man has died following a shark attack in Far North Queensland.

items.title: Live: F1 faces threat of first wet race in new era, Piastri starts fourth
items.description: Oscar Piastri starts on the second row of the grid for this morning's Formula 1 Canadian Grand Prix. Follow live.

items.title: Giants create AFL history with onslaught, Dogs down Dees in classic
items.description: Greater Western Sydney has left reigning premier Brisbane reeling with a record-breaking goal surge, while the Bulldogs get home in a see-sawing contest against the Demons.

items.title: North Queensland crowd raises record figure for Arrow and MND charity
items.description: North Queensland climbs into the NRL's top six with an impressive 30-18 victory over South Sydney in Townsville, where fans raise thousands of dollars for the Fight MND charity.

items.title: Recent fall in auction clearance rates could be good news for first home buyers
items.description: Negative sentiment around the property sector has started to make its way into the marketplace since the federal budget, but real estate experts say it may prove to be good news for first-home buyers.

items.title: At least 24 killed in Pakistan train blast claimed by separatist militants
items.description: A bomb blast has hit a shuttle train carrying Pakistani security personnel and their families in the latest major attack claimed by separatist militants.

items.title: Politics and faith collide over choice for Tibet's next Dalai Lama
items.description: Tibetan Buddhists believe the Dalai Lama decides when and where he will reincarnate. But China's ruling Communist Party says it must choose who will replace him.

items.title: One dead, 21 feared trapped under rubble after Philippines building collapse
items.description: Search and rescue operations are underway in the Philippines after a nine-storey building collapsed.

items.title: Aussie the first winner at French Open after injury retirement
items.description: James Duckworth gets an easy path into the second round of the French Open after his opponent retires midway through the second set.

items.title: Man charged after 14yo restaurant worker threatened with knife
items.description: Police say a 30-year-old man who allegedly demanded money from a 14-year-old worker at knifepoint, on the NSW Central Coast, was tackled to the ground by two other men.

items.title: How these people's lives have changed since quitting alcohol
items.description: Here's what you had to say about leaving alcohol behind and how it's impacted your health, friendships and lifestyle.

items.title: The generational housing clash reaches a bloody end in this new film
items.description: Plus the rom-com of yore returns in Finding Emily, the farmyard mystery that's been delighting audiences, and a gory Hollywood video game adaptation filmed on the Gold Coast.

items.title: My dog Teddy was more than just a pet. We needed each other
items.description: Judith Geppert has an impressive resume of achievements and celebrations, but her capabilities are often questioned. Her dog Teddy, however, never treated her any differently.

items.title: The scale of the mouse plague is hard to fathom. Here's a visualisation

items.title: Air and land search continues for missing 31-year-old man in Arnhem Land
items.description: The NT Police Force says it continues to hold concerns for the welfare of the man, who was last seen early on Friday.

items.title: Former actor Rachel Ward became a farmhand at 65 and found her purpose
items.description: With the country wind in her grey hair, cow dung on her boots and not a skerrick of make-up, former actor Rachel Ward has found her place, sharing her passion for regenerative farming.

items.title: Jamie-Lee Price thinks fake tan could solve a lot of netball's problems
items.description: Frustrated at netball's stagnation, this is what Jamie-Lee Price wants to see happen to keep her sport moving with the times.

items.title: Put away the dictionary. It's spelling bee time!
items.description: Know your way around a homonym? Nah, me neither but come in and have a crack at our Sunday quiz anyway.

items.title: 'I've had enough': Why this loyal Labor voter is switching to One Nation
items.description: The next opportunity to test support for One Nation in Western Sydney will be the state election on March 13. Already, disillusioned Labor voter Silvana Rota is ready to "give them a go".

items.title: Suspect dead after gunshots send White House into lockdown
items.description: Reporters were told to sprint into the Press Briefing Room after gunshots were heard nearby.

items.title: Maldives cave dive deaths leave us with many theories and one big question
items.description: The question of why experienced divers would descend to depths of more than 50 metres on a single tank of air — let alone enter a cave while doing so — baffles members of the relatively close-knit deep-sea diving community.
